steps.content: [Inner World - Aberration 2]

At last, the familiar stone stele comes into view. Yet your eyes find more than just the path out of this nightmare. Stretching between you and the distant exit lies a sprawling field of ashen gravestones, jutting from the earth at crooked angles.
Before each one, small clusters of shadowy figures stand in silence. Your fingers tighten unconsciously. They share the same hue as the ribbon of light those drifting fish became.
Their heads hang low, hands clasped before their chests, bodies tilting forward ever so slightly as faint murmurs slip from their lips.
It looks almost like an act of worship.
The copper coin sears without warning. You fail to hold back a muffled groan.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Mmph...!
In near-perfect unison, the shadowy figures all turn to face you.
You hold your breath and clench the copper coin tight. Even as your palm sizzles from the heat, you dare not loosen your grip.
(Transition 2s)
One by one, the shadowy figures at last turn back. The whispered murmur rises once more.
You release a slow, careful breath. The copper coin in your hand gradually cools.
It seems you must not draw their attention... That leaves only one path forward: to search for the true exit without disturbing their vigil.

options: Hold your breath and proceed carefully

steps.content: You are closing in on the way out.
Then you hear it again.
[Empty scene + bell sound effect]

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Following the <color=#fb9259>copper coin</color> will get you nowhere.
[Empty scene 1s + footsteps & bell]

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: And where exactly do you think you'll run to? It's no different from doing nothing and waiting to die.
The chime draws nearer. She will find you soon; it is only a matter of time.
<i>The copper coin... She seems fixated on it. Perhaps you could use it to lure her attention elsewhere.
You grip the coin in your palm, your thumb tracing its charred, blackened face.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm sorry...
The coin flies from your palm, arcing through the air past the tombstone you crouch behind. It disappears into the haze beyond and strikes the ground with a faint, ringing chime.

steps.speaker: Distant Specters
steps.content: <i><color=#7683a2>Aaarrghh!</color><i>
You yank your body back and shrink entirely into the darkness pooling behind a gravestone.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Heh...
The footsteps falter for a moment, then move off into the haze. The rustle of cloth reaches your ears, then a quiet laugh somewhere far off. And finally, all falls still.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Phew.
You slowly peek out and gauge the distance to the stone stele far away. Now is your moment. She has moved away. Find the real exit while you can.
[Screen flash + vibration + sound of stone shattering]

All around you, tombstones explode without warning. Debris flies past, sharp shards slicing across your cheek. The ghostly green silhouettes shatter into points of light before they can even utter a sound, dissolving into the air.
